newsitem.title: USA: Bridgeport, Conn weighs bids to develop waterfront.
newsitem.headline: Bridgeport, Conn weighs bids to develop waterfront.

text.p: The mayor of Bridgeport, Conn., on Tuesday said that he had gotten bids from three developers interested in building on the Steel Point waterfront property, a 25-acre tract.
The proposals range in size from $200 million to $1 billion and all include some public financing as part of the package, Mayor Joseph Ganim said, in prepared remarks.

The various proposals, all designed to draw people to the city, include retail development, hotels, office and residential space, waterfront activities and "destination attractions," which were not specified.

"We plan to make the final and accepted proposal commensurate with all of the other development plans that we are working on in the city. This includes a sports and entertainment complex, an intermodal transportation center and continued downtown improvements," the mayor said.
The three developers are Hines, Bridgeport Maritime Partners and The Conroy Development Company.
